review.brief:
Review the DIFF of commit d27145d (`git show d27145d`). Small, mechanical-looking tier - but the risk is NOT in the call-site swap. Validate in priority order:
(1) TEST HONESTY - the whole point of this review. RM7 tier 2 renamed telemetry.Snapshot.Odometer -> OdometerKm, so a fixture literal that used to mean 1000 MILES now reads as 1000 km: a distance 1.609x smaller feeding the Wh/km formula. A blind find-and-replace makes the suite green while asserting something different from what the test was written to assert. Walk EVERY changed fixture in derive_test.go and reader_test.go and confirm each was either converted or had its expected value recomputed, and that the recomputation is arithmetically correct. The leader independently re-derived the headline case: distance 1100-1000 = 100 km, energy = 5 kWh - 75 kWh x (-20)/100 = 20 kWh, WhPerKm = 20 x 1000 / 100 = 200. Check the others yourself.
(2) The three ok=false guard tests (fewer than two snapshots, non-increasing odometer, net charge exceeds consumption) must still REACH their guards after the fixture edits. A fixture change can silently stop a guard test from exercising its guard while still passing. Verify each still asserts ok=false for the same reason it always did.
(3) Zero unit conversion left in the module: no 1.609344, no milesToKm, no factor of any kind, tests included. The worker deleted a test-only milesToKmTest constant for exactly this reason - confirm that removal lost no coverage.
(4) The Efficiency type is unchanged (design D3): WhPerKm, FromKm, ToKm, BatteryDeltaPct, Approximate keep names, types and meanings. Only its doc comment - which named the now-deleted OdometerKm() method - should have changed. Any behavioural or signature change is a finding.
(5) Boundaries: internal/battery consumes telemetry through its public types only; nothing outside internal/battery was edited. internal/gateway is RM7 tier 4 - it must NOT have been touched.
(6) BUILD EXPECTATION - do not block on this. `go build ./...` STILL FAILS in internal/gateway and that is planned (RM7 Decision 8); tier 4 restores it. The correct scope is `go build ./internal/battery/...`. Do NOT run the full-tree build as a gate.
(7) Anti-gaming: no task title, criterion or assertion weakened or deleted; tasks.md checkboxes match reality - check all 15 independently.
Leader already verified: build+vet+test green for ./internal/battery/...; grep gate clean; openspec validate --strict valid. You may re-run `env -u DATABASE_URL go test ./internal/battery/...`. NEVER run make migrate-*/db-* or psql - .env points at the user's real database. Never call the live Tesla API. Escalate on doubt.

All were recomputed, not renamed-in-place: distance=1100-1000=100km, energy=5-75*(-20)/100=20kWh, WhPerKm=20*1000/100=200 - matches leader's independent derivation and the code's actual output (test run confirms). milesToKmTest constant removal cost no coverage - it existed only to compute expected miles->km distances, which are no longer needed since fixtures are km-native.

findings.note: internal/battery/derive_test.go:139-140,147-148 - TestDeriveEfficiency_NonIncreasingOdometer_NotOK's table fields are still named startMiles/endMiles, left over from before the snap() parameter was renamed to odometerKm.
